Laptop Screen Hinge Repairs Gold Coast. Loose, Broken Or Detached, Fixed Fast.

Common Signs You Need A Hinge Repair

A Faulty Hinge Rarely Fixes Itself.

Ignoring a hinge issue can lead to further damage to your screen, keyboard or internal components, and a bigger repair bill. Here's what to watch for.

↔️

Loose Or Broken Hinge

The screen is wobbly or won't stay in place at the angle you set it.

🔒

Screen Won't Open Or Close Properly

Stiff or unresponsive hinges can lead to cracks or breakage over time.

📐

Screen Separating From The Base

A visible gap between screen and keyboard means the hinge is failing.

🔊

Grinding Or Clicking Noises

Strange sounds when opening or closing usually mean internal hinge damage.

💥

Cracks Around The Hinge Area

Visible physical damage near the hinge is a clear sign of wear and tear.

⚠️

Left Untreated?

Ignoring hinge issues risks permanent screen damage, higher repair costs, and potential data loss if the laptop stops functioning.

Our Process

How A Hinge Repair Works.

1️⃣

Free Assessment

A no-obligation inspection of the hinge damage, with a transparent quote before any work starts.

2️⃣

Repair Or Replacement

Depending on severity, we either repair the existing hinge or fit a high-quality replacement part.

3️⃣

Quality Testing

We test hinge stability and confirm the laptop opens and closes smoothly, without strain.

4️⃣

Pickup & Warranty

Your repaired laptop is ready for pickup, backed by a warranty for peace of mind.

What Affects The Cost

How Much Does A Hinge Repair Cost?

Every laptop and every hinge failure is a little different, so we give you a free, transparent quote before booking any work.

  • Extent Of Damage, minor adjustments cost less than a full replacement.
  • Laptop Brand & Model, some designs are more complex to work on than others.
  • Parts Availability, the price of high-quality replacement hinges varies by model.
Fix My Laptop Hinge
Brands We Repair

Every Major Laptop Brand, Including MacBooks.

🍏

Apple MacBook (Air & Pro)

Loose or stiff hinges are a common MacBook issue, we repair or replace the hinge assembly without damaging the chassis.

💻

HP, Dell, ASUS, Acer, Lenovo, Toshiba

Reliable hinge repairs for everyday and business laptops of every shape and size.

🎮

Gaming Laptops & Custom Models

Specialised repairs for the heavier, differently-engineered hinges on high-performance gaming machines.

Not sure if we service your laptop? Get in touch for a free quote.

Frequently Asked Questions

Laptop Hinge Repair Questions, Answered.

How long does a laptop hinge repair take?

Most repairs are completed within 24-48 hours, depending on part availability for your specific model.

Is it worth repairing a laptop hinge?

Absolutely, fixing a hinge is significantly cheaper than replacing the entire laptop, and leaving it can cause further damage to the screen or internals.

Do you offer a warranty on hinge repairs?

Yes, every hinge repair comes with a warranty for peace of mind.

Can you repair MacBook hinges?

Yes, we repair hinges on MacBook Air, MacBook Pro and other Apple laptops.

Related Services

Hinge Sorted, Anything Else Needs Attention?

A loose hinge sometimes comes with a cracked or flickering panel, check our laptop screen replacement page if the display's affected too. While it's on the bench, it's also worth checking the battery health. For any other fault, see our general laptop repairs page.
